events.title_zh: Shura Council Speaker, Swiss National Council President Discuss Bilateral Ties, Parliamentary Cooperation
events.title_original: Shura Council Speaker, Swiss National Council President Discuss Bilateral Ties, Parliamentary Cooperation
events.summary: Doha, November 08 (QNA) - HE Speaker of the Shura Council, Hassan bin Abdullah Al Ghanim, met Sunday with HE President of the National Council of Switzerland, Pierre-André Page, who is visiting Qatar, as part of efforts to strengthen parliamentary cooperation between the two friendly countries. The meeting reviewed the distinguished bilateral relations between Qatar and Switzerland and ways to strengthen and develop them, particularly in the parliamentary field. The two sides also exchanged views on several issues of mutual interest. They discussed regional and international developments amid the challenges and tensions facing the region.  （原文待翻译）
